name: Calculadora de TMB e TDEE
tagline: Calcule o metabolismo basal e o gasto calórico diário
description: Calculate your Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) and Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE) using Mifflin-St Jeor, Harris-Benedict, and Katch-McArdle formulas. Shows calorie targets for cutting, maintaining, and bulking with macro breakdown.
metaTitle: Calculadora de TMB/TDEE – Calcule Taxa Metabólica Basal e Necessidade Calórica
metaDescription: Calcule a Taxa Metabólica Basal (TMB) e o Gasto Energético Total Diário (TDEE) para planejar dieta e ganho de massa.
